title: Kandinsky S2V 1.0: Audio-Driven Avatar Video Generation
title_zh: Kandinsky S2V 1.0：基于音频驱动的数字人视频生成

paragraphs.en: Kandinsky S2V 1.0 是一个基于音频的虚拟形象视频生成模型系列，能够生成与语音同步的人类动画视频。 We present Kandinsky S2V 1.0, an open family of speech-to-video models for controllable audio-driven human animation, comprising Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Lite (2B parameters) and Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Pro (21B parameters). From a single reference image, a speech waveform, and a text prompt, the models generate long-form 25 FPS video in which lip motion, expression, pose, and gesture follow the speech. The architecture draws text and audio conditioning from one Qwen2.5-Omni model and adds a reference-aware three-scale visual memory. Training starts from the Kandinsky 5.0 Video foundation models [1] and combines mixed reference-memory layouts with an area-adaptive face loss. The training corpus contains 1.17M single-speaker clips selected by active-speaker detection, with captions generated directly in English and Russian. A side-by-side human evaluation against the strongest open-source baseline and two proprietary commercial models shows that Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Pro performs comparably to or better than these models on average and is also preferred for lip synchronization. On common speech to video benchmarks, Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Lite and Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Pro rank among the top performing models according to mean rank over five reported metrics. Beyond the base models, we provide π-Flow distilled variants of both Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Lite and Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Pro. The distilled Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Pro model generates video in 16 sampling steps without classifier-free guidance, achieving a 5.4 times end-to-end speedup over the base model, while matching or exceeding it on nearly all reported benchmark metrics. To accelerate open research and deployment in speech-to-video generation, we release the code, model checkpoints, and diffusers integration under the MIT license.
paragraphs.zh: Kandinsky S2V 1.0 是一个基于音频的虚拟形象视频生成模型系列，能够生成与语音同步的人类动画视频。我们提出 Kandinsky S2V 1.0，这是一个用于可控音频驱动人类动画的开放语音转视频模型家族，包括 Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Lite（2B 参数）和 Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Pro（21B 参数）。 通过单张参考图像、语音波形和文本提示，这些模型能够生成长格式的 25 FPS 视频，其中唇部动作、表情、姿势和手势均与语音同步。 该架构从单个 Qwen2.5-Omni 模型获取文本和音频条件信息，并加入一个参考感知的三尺度视觉记忆模块。 训练基于 Kandinsky 5.0 Video 基础模型 [1]，并结合了混合参考记忆布局与区域自适应面部损失函数。 训练语料库包含 117 万个通过主动说话人检测筛选的单说话人片段，其字幕以英语和俄语直接生成。 通过与最强开源基线模型及两款专有商业模型进行并排人类评估，结果显示 Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Pro 在平均表现上与之相当或更优，并且在唇部同步方面也更受青睐。 在常见的语音转视频基准测试中，根据五项报告指标的平均排名，Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Lite 和 Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Pro 均位列表现最佳模型之列。 除了基础模型外，我们还提供了基于 π-Flow 蒸馏的 Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Lite 和 Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Pro 变体。 经过蒸馏的 Kandinsky S2V 1.0 Pro 模型无需无分类器引导即可在 16 个采样步骤内生成视频，相比基础模型实现了 5.4 倍的端到端加速，同时在几乎所有报告的基准指标上均与之相当或更优。 为加速语音转视频生成领域的开放研究与部署，我们基于 MIT 许可证发布了代码、模型检查点以及 Diffusers 集成。
